en.hero-description: Work with files, convert images and PDFs, and inspect your system with one Python import.
en.copy-failed: Select and copy the code manually.

en.api-get_random_password: Generate a random string for password demos.
en.api-is_pressed: Check if a specific key is pressed

en.api-get_mac_address: Get MAC address of the current machine
en.api-get_machine_info: Get the hostname, IP address, MAC address, platform, and Python version.

en.api-get_file_hash: Compute a file hash (sha256, md5, etc.)

en.api-ping_host: Check whether a host is reachable
en.api-get_folder_size: Get the total size of a folder in MB
en.api-function_time: Measure how long a function takes to run
